name: @ASYNC
description: First line: run this script in the background.

name: @SIMPLE
description: Hold a key while its Launchpad pad or demo mouse button is held.

name: @LOAD_LAYOUT
description: First line: load a layout from user_layouts.

name: STRING
description: Type the text following the command.

name: DELAY
description: Wait. The unit is seconds, including fractional values.

name: TAP
description: Press and release a key, optionally repeating it.

name: PRESS
description: Hold a key until RELEASE or RELEASE_ALL.

name: RELEASE
description: Release a held key.

name: RELEASE_ALL
description: Release all keys held by scripts.

name: WEB
description: Open a website in your browser.

name: WEB_NEW
description: Ask the browser to open a new window.

name: CODE
description: Run an external program. Use an executable path; OS-specific commands need adapting.

name: OPEN
description: Open a file or folder with its default application.

name: SOUND
description: Play a one-shot effect from user_sounds. Volume is 0–100.

name: SOUND_TRACK
description: One pad toggles play/pause/resume. Fades are milliseconds. Pause preserves the playhead. Track files are relative to user_sounds.

name: SOUND_PAUSE
description: Pause all soundtrack pads, on every page. Omit fade_ms to use each track’s pause fade.

name: SOUND_RESUME
description: Continue paused soundtracks at their saved positions. Uses each play fade unless overridden.

name: SOUND_STOP
description: Stop all audio. A later play starts from the beginning. Optional fade is milliseconds.

name: SOUND_SKIP
description: Skip forward or backward. Without coordinates, affects all active tracks. With coordinates, targets that pad on this page. Paused tracks stay paused.

name: SOUND_SEEK
description: Jump to an absolute time, in seconds. Optional pad coordinates target this page; otherwise affects all active tracks.

name: WAIT_UNPRESSED
description: Wait until this pad is released.

name: M_MOVE
description: Move the pointer relative to its current position.

name: M_SET
description: Move the pointer to screen coordinates.

name: M_SCROLL
description: Scroll the wheel; negative values reverse direction.

name: M_LINE
description: Move along a line between two screen points.

name: M_LINE_MOVE
description: Move along a line relative to the current pointer.

name: M_LINE_SET
description: Move in a line to an absolute point.

name: M_STORE
description: Remember the current pointer location in this script.

name: M_RECALL
description: Return to the location saved by M_STORE.

name: M_RECALL_LINE
description: Return to the stored pointer location along a line.

name: LABEL
description: Define a jump/repeat label.

name: GOTO_LABEL
description: Jump to a label in this script.

name: IF_PRESSED_GOTO_LABEL
description: Jump if this pad is still held.

name: IF_UNPRESSED_GOTO_LABEL
description: Jump if this pad is released.

name: REPEAT_LABEL
description: Repeat a label a limited number of times.

name: IF_PRESSED_REPEAT_LABEL
description: Repeat while the pad is held, up to count times.

name: IF_UNPRESSED_REPEAT_LABEL
description: Repeat while released, up to count times.

name: RESET_REPEATS
description: Reset this script’s repeat counters.

name: PAGE
description: Switch to a page by name or 1-based number. Background tracks keep playing.

name: PAGE_NEXT
description: Switch to the next page, wrapping at the end.

name: PAGE_PREV
description: Switch to the previous page.
